entities.summary: Joseph Blandisi is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward for SKA Saint Petersburg of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected in the sixth round, 162nd overall, by the Colorado Avalanche of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2012 NHL Entry Draft and has previously played for the New Jersey Devils, Anaheim Ducks, and Pittsburgh Penguins.
